message: 不穏ではない影

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you so much~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That covers just about all the shops, doesn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I'm glad everyone looked so happy.」
We make the rounds greeting the folks in the shopping district who helped us out during KiraFes.

name: Lolotte
message: 「There were so many people saying they'd love to participate again next time, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「It'd be great if we can do it again next year.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's definitely do it!! I'm sure plenty of people inspired by this event will step right up and volunteer.」

name: Synn
message: 「When that happens, wouldn't it be perfect if you became Student Council President and took the lead, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Me, the President......? I can hardly imagine that.」

name: Synn
message: 「You'll be fine. It's not really that tough of a position anyway.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Do you really think so? Watching you, President, I can't help feeling it's a job meant only for the chosen few.」

name: Synn
message: 「If it's you, Lolotte--someone who always takes the initiative--I'm sure you can pull it off.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're right, leave it to me!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wait, hearing you say that actually makes me kind of embarrassed...... Ehehe♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it's still a ways off anyway. Take your time thinking it over.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When push comes to shove, I'll have you serve as my advisor, President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Me, an advisor...... I can hardly imagine that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee. You're saying the exact same thing I just did.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoops.」

name: Young Girl
message: 「Staaare--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What's the matter, President?」
Everywhere Lolotte and I went, I could feel an intense gaze fixed on us.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, nothing...... I just feel like someone's been watching us for a while now.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I have been watching you the whole time, though, President?」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's embarrassing in its own way, so could you spare me\s01」
I'll deliberately look away to let her drop her guard.
And then turn around without any warning!!

name: Young Girl
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「She got away...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A fish?」

name: Synn
message: 「Not that big. It was a petite girl」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hoho~ So that's what they call a groupie, is it」

name: Synn
message: 「And I feel like I've seen her somewhere before, or maybe not...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「From an idol's perspective, I hear that's just how fans are」

name: Synn
message: 「First of all, I'm not an idol」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Isn't the Student Council President the idol of the academy?」

name: Synn
message: 「That only applies to last year」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'd love to see Ria-chan sing and dance... Aah」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still, having girls chase after you makes you quite the ladies' man, President~~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama isn't cut out to be a ladies' man. If anyone fits that bill, it's yours truly」

name: Synn
message: 「What is a monochrome character even talking about」

name: Paqy
message: 「Seriously, some people sure have weird tastes」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on a second. It's not necessarily me she's following, right」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then, is it Mr. Panda?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not like she's Misa」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is true」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, cut that out!」
